zh-CN.name: 引用与依据
zh-CN.description: 为原始资料和分析结果登记引用依据，保留来源版本与具体位置。
features: 定位文档页码、章节、表格行列与结果字段
区分原文摘录、归纳结论与计算结果
在回答和报告中复用依据编号，并回查来源

en-US.name: Citations & Evidence
en-US.description: Registers evidence from source material and analysis results, preserving source versions and locations.
features: Locates pages, sections, table rows and columns, and result fields
Distinguishes excerpts, summaries and computed results
Reuses evidence IDs in answers and reports with source lookup
